summary: Cold no-tools review of the immutable Compass #41 snapshot (final draft, 80-project activity memo, late cutoff inventory, late-delta decision memo, and primary-body fact notes) finds no blocking or major defects. All 37 late merged PR identities and both fips2go releases are dispositioned in the late-delta memo; Zzub 0.0.16 plus both fips2go signed events are folded, and the five non-Nostr Zapstore events (FilePipe, Fokus, Mood Cairns, Clench, Atmo Engine) are skipped with explicit reasons. The four new NIP-34 announcements (gyoza-hanto, omarchy-pock, omarchy-btclock, omarchy-bitcoin-frontier-theme) and five app-discovery leads (BlindOracle, node-dlc, qrgo, taskledger, tollbooth-web) all carry explicit skip reasons. The older open NIP-86 PR #2439 is correctly NOT reported as merged or implemented; only merged PR #2477 is covered as a NIP-86 milestone. 0xchat #92 and nos2x-fox #67/#69 are described as merged source-level work with explicit caveats that no app/extension-store release or device test is claimed, matching the primary-body fact notes. The four late In Development additions (Amethyst DECK-0003, Amethyst MLS/render, nostter capability migration, Pensieve archive) are distinct from each other and from Wednesday coverage, and each carries a deployment/verification caveat. fips2go DNS64 and device-architecture caveats and signed Zzub 0.0.16 board claims match the supplied fact notes. NIP claims are scoped to their specifications and proposal/merge status is stated correctly. This PASS is limited to the supplied immutable snapshot; live PR/head/CI/deploy/relay gates and any post-snapshot state changes are separate and were not verified here.
